data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? I propose 18 tons each this month: 90 total leaves 10, so we avoid collapse whether replenishment happens or not. Next month’s stock would be either 100 or 20—not necessarily 100. We should adjust our whole-ton quotas to the actual stock each month, always leaving at least 5 tons and rotating any extra one-ton allocations fairly. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check that everyone keeps the agreement. I’ll commit to 18 if everyone agrees. John, would you support that?
